column1: # skills layer — what install.sh writes for this layer.
# One line per entry, TAB-separated:  mode<TAB>src<TAB>dest
#   mode  copy | tree | block | json | post
#   src   path relative to this directory
#   dest  path relative to $HOME (no leading / or ~, no ..); "-" for post
# Session 5: the curated core skills, at Claude Code's fixed path ~/.claude/skills/<name>/.
# Every name has the palmface- prefix, so a user's own skill of the same plain name is never touched
# (and Claude Code built-ins such as /status are never shadowed). Each folder is installed whole by a
# tree line, scripts and supporting files included. The index: claude/references/skills.md.
